pages.text: Noquis: potato, dough and tomato in a Farmer's Delight pot. Luck and Full Belly.$(br2)Empanada: Good Vibes (baked).$(br2)Fugazzeta: onion, cheese and dough. Good Vibes and Full Belly.
Raw empanada: dough, raw beef, onion and an egg (crafting table, makes 3). Then cook them like any meat: campfire, furnace, smoker or grill.
